item.title: Jimmie Johnson to End NASCAR Driving Career After 2027 Daytona 500
item.description: Seven-time Cup champion says the passion to compete is gone as he shifts focus to building Legacy Motor Club.

item.title: Why So Many Stars Never Win the Daytona 500
item.description: Kyle Busch has led 342 laps without a win, Tony Stewart went 0-for-17, and a long list of champions never claimed the Harley J. Earl Trophy.

item.title: Allgaier Takes Blame for 20-Car Daytona 500 Wreck
item.description: A frontstretch miscue on lap 124 triggered a massive crash that eliminated several contenders and reshaped Sunday’s race.

item.title: Tyler Reddick Captures First Daytona 500 in Crash-Filled Race
item.description: Thirty-seven cars were involved in accidents as Reddick emerged from “Daytona madness” to win NASCAR’s biggest event.

item.title: Joey Logano Overcomes Damage to Finish Third in Daytona 500
item.description: After being “swallowed up by the field,” Logano charged late to secure a podium result—then went straight to the infield care center.

item.title: Last-Lap Scramble Left 23XI Racing Celebrating First Daytona 500 Victory
item.description: Nine cars finished within three-tenths of a second in a dramatic final lap at Daytona International Speedway, but William Byron falls short of historic three-peat.

item.title: Tyler Reddick Rebounds from Winless Season with Daytona 500 Victory
item.description: After a difficult 2025 and family health struggles, Reddick opened 2026 with the biggest win of his career.

item.title: Carmakers Took a $50 Billion Loss on EVs
item.description: Turns out the market was not nearly as big as it seemed it would be.

item.title: Formula 1 Extends Barcelona Through 2032 in Rotating Agreement
item.description: Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya will rotate with Spa-Francorchamps beyond 2026 as Madrid takes over the Spanish Grand Prix.

item.title: Billy Torrence Returns to Full-Time NHRA Top Fuel in 2026
item.description: The CAPCO team owner will drive the full Mission Foods Drag Racing Series schedule while Steve Torrence sits out.
